title: Select authoritative sales order sources in purchase order forms
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Add bounded purchase-order sales source candidate and exact stored-source resolution APIs using live enabled identity, existing purchase-order permission and current customer scope. Reuse PurchaseSalesOrderLinkRules eligibility: approved nondeleted noncancelled sales order, authoritative customer, product/unit compatibility on final save. Apply scope before count/paging, return safe DTO only. Do not require matching currencies or change original commercial prices. Stored historical source unavailable annotations must not disclose foreign customer/order fields.

Wire optional owning sales-order selector into existing purchase-order create/edit/detail forms. Authoritative customer/order number comes from chosen source; customer changes invalidate selection, outdated responses cannot restore previous context. Preserve existing stored historical link on reopen and amounts on selection; explicit unlink only while editable. Final locked create/update validation remains authoritative and rejects forged IDs. Real SQL API own/foreign/revoked/disabled/cancelled/unapproved and save denial, executable JS create/edit/reopen/customer-change/stale/unlink/error tests, unit and safe Release verification; browser evidence or accurate blocker.
